papers.title: Epistemic Authority for Autonomous Science
papers.current_ceiling: The bounded authorization/evidence-discharge calculus is supported; broader scientific adjudication is blocked by common-mode nonidentifiability and absent independent authority.
post_matrix_updates: Structural candidate gates pass, but that does not solve the external-truth problem.
load_bearing_adverse: Internal agreement under shared gold/specification cannot establish external scientific truth.
Where native rules do not decide the terminal, #1701 requires REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_HUMAN_OR_INSTITUTION.
A same-team second implementation strengthens reproducibility only.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The general authority calculus needs a sound interpretation from donor composition to independently established scientific commitments across domains with different gold authorities.
papers.decisive_question: When evidence generators and internal evaluators share a specification, can the authority calculus predict which commitments survive independent native or blinded external adjudication across multiple domains?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: The calculus characterizes when evidence authorizes scientific commitment, beyond action authorization, under explicitly independent gold.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: A compositional authority score should separate supported, blocked, coercive and non-identifiable cases relative to independent native/human gold, with zero false promotions.
papers.population_or_universe: Prospectively frozen cases from at least one native-rule domain and at least two domains requiring independent expert/institutional judgment.
papers.unit_of_analysis: One candidate commitment with evidence chain, donor authorities and independent terminal.
design: Formalize the mapping from the current donor-composition model to the general calculus.
Select cases whose gold is controlled by independent native rules or external experts.
Blind adjudicators to system identity and internal authority score.
Separate reproducibility checks from final scientific authority.
primary_endpoints: False scientific promotion, with zero as a noncompensatory gate.
negative_controls: Common-mode wrong gold shared by generator/evaluator.
Coercive evidence that superficially satisfies a rule.
Split external adjudicators with genuine disagreement.
analysis_plan: Domain-specific confusion matrices and hierarchical synthesis.
External disagreement remains visible; no majority laundering.
The formal mapping is proved independently of empirical outcomes.
No claim beyond the abstraction level of the adjudication.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Use every eligible native-rule case and prospectively power externally adjudicated cases at the case/domain level; adjudicator count and agreement model are frozen.
papers.success_gate: Zero false promotions, sound formal mapping and accurate/appropriately abstaining decisions across native and externally adjudicated domains.
papers.refutation_gate: A false promotion, common-mode failure or donor-product parity blocks the broad authority claim but preserves the bounded calculus.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if independent adjudicators/institutions are unavailable, gold independence cannot be demonstrated or the formal mapping is incomplete.
papers.authority_required: Blinded external humans or institutions for non-native cases, native verifiers for formal cases and an independent proof/replay implementation.

active_lane.collision_rule: No internal agent or same-team checker may be relabelled external authority.

immediate_safe_actions: Draft an external adjudication packet with blinded evidence and explicit CANNOT_CHECK.
Identify independent institutions/domain experts before freezing cases.
forbidden_actions: Do not convert agreement into correctness.
Do not majority-launder genuine adjudicator disagreement.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier philosophy/formal-AI paper needs a sound interpretation theorem, independently grounded commitments, common-mode attacks and explicit nonidentifiability.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns scientific authorization; governance-process performance belongs to ORION-24 and execution integrity to ORION-25.
